“Utsotanv(i)” Afterbirth.

Utsotanv(i) - it was in afterbirth. It’s still inside the cow. I would wait two or three days for it to pass on its own. But sometimes it won’t do it itself, then I have to take it inside. Then I get a long glove. When you find it, just like the buttons that are here [gestures], there’s a button there [gestures]. [inside cow] And that’s what you have to find. When you take them off, then you can pull it out. I have some medicine and I just put it in there, and the cow gets alright. Sometimes, that ‘breedback’ that they do, they would wait a little longer if that happens. I don’t know why.
